decisions.summary: The belt's hit region is its record's `cover`: the union of a disc per drawn windbreak clump (seat out to crown_reach + 0.3 clump) plus a conifer-led belt's rank crowns at their drawn radius (stocking.crown_cover), which the page already prefers over `poly`
decisions.why: Row 144's fix is literally 'build the belt's hover region from the clumps the page draws'; the region is built from exactly those clumps and the rank crowns painted over them. Re-derived from the manifests: the box ground the page lit with no cover is 17946 (17%) Inashiro, 102921 (69%) Kuwabata, 0 Sawada, as m:wave71-belt-cover records, so the empty arm of F3 is no longer lit. The disc is an envelope of where a clump's crowns can stand rather than each crown's own disc; that is a precision choice inside the fix, not a departure from it (the crown ink keeps its own widened hit copies).

decisions.summary: Alder clumps (belt seats in the marsh) are left out of the windbreak's cover
decisions.why: They are drawn under their own class `alder`, not `windbreak`, so they are not windbreak clumps the page draws; none of the three belts has an alder clump today (alder 0 on each).

decisions.summary: The region's rule recorded as a CONVENTION at the claim line in stands.py and crown_cover's docstring
decisions.why: A hover region is a map drawing convention; constitution XII requires the class, and it is labeled.

decisions.summary: Row 145 (water-mouth grove drawn in the windbreak mix) DEFERRED_ON_MEASURE in audit/scope.py: village_grove runs on every kept hamlet but no kept map lays a role water_mouth grove
decisions.why: Implied by the GM's own amendment 8 ('limit ourselves to code actually executed by magistracies, country shrines, and scripted hamlets') as the accepted FR-010 operationalizes it: 'a claim whose value no kept map reads though its unit runs is deferred with its measured reason'. Measured here: the five hamlets' records carry roles windbreak/copse or none, the country shrine's is role shrine, no pool file names water_mouth (Mizuguchi only by its name), and the only callers pass windbreak or copse (hinterland stages) or windbreak (the legacy roller). The claim is the mix of a grove no kept map draws, so the fix would change no kept map. Same mechanism as the fork band (wave 65).

decisions.summary: scope.json and dev/claims-deferred.json re-derived: besides row 145, found rows from waves 64-65 enter as kept, and units the kept maps no longer execute (_pull_back, junction_floor, placer._strict_seat) move to deferred, with row 179 (_pull_back#trim floor) kept->deferred
decisions.why: The mechanical FR-010 derivation from the kept maps' gen-cache, re-run when a wave lands, as FR-010 requires; row 179 was already closed at wave 66 (waves.json), so no open work leaves scope.
